e.title: AI 改写保险技能
e.summary: AI 正在改写保险行业最重要的技能（技能需求重构分析）
e.body: 「AI is rewriting which skills matter most in insurance」（insurancebusinessmag）：AI 改写保险行业技能需求——最重要的技能在变化。对 RIAA：保险技能需求的重构——与 [[iii-underwriter-ai-talent]]（核保 AI 人才）、[[ai-two-track-workforce]]（双轨劳动力）、[[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（混合角色）配套：技能变化的行业共识；理解「哪些技能最重要」的变化方向（AI/数据/精算融合）；求职技能投资的行业依据。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：insurancebusinessmag 文章确认（AI 改写保险技能），未通读
e.summary_en: AI is rewriting which skills matter most in insurance (skill-demand restructuring analysis)
e.summary_hk: AI 正在改寫保險行業最重要的技能（技能需求重構分析）
e.body_en: 'AI is rewriting which skills matter most in insurance' (insurancebusinessmag): AI rewriting the skill demands of the insurance industry — the most important skills are changing. For RIAA: the restructuring of insurance skill demands — with [[iii-underwriter-ai-talent]] (underwriter AI talent), [[ai-two-track-workforce]] (two-track workforce) and [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] (hybrid roles) it frames the industry consensus of skill changes; understand the direction of 'which skills matter most' (AI/data/actuarial fusion); industry evidence for career-skill investment.
e.body_hk: 「AI is rewriting which skills matter most in insurance」（insurancebusinessmag）：AI 改寫保險行業技能需求——最重要的技能在變化。對 RIAA：保險技能需求的重構——與 [[iii-underwriter-ai-talent]]（核保 AI 人才）、[[ai-two-track-workforce]]（雙軌勞動力）、[[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（混合角色）配套：技能變化的行業共識；理解「哪些技能最重要」的變化方向（AI/數據/精算融合）；求職技能投資的行業依據。
